item.title: Pretty interior! Lovely town! Has a guest apartment! C. 1930 in NC. $450,000
item.description: This house has a pretty interior! I love the town of Tryon, it’s so quaint! There is a guest apartment with separate entrance that is not included in the square footage. The house was built in 1930. It is located on .63 acre in Tryon, North Carolina. The house features a screened in front porch, wood floors, crown moulding, updated kitchen, wainscoting, pretty light fixtures, updated bathrooms, claw foot tub and wide baseboards. item.title: Potential! Almost 15 acres in Virginia. C. 1923. $248,000
item.description: This house has potential! They place all the value in the acreage, but I have seen worse. The house was built in 1923. It is located on 14.68 acres in Powhatan, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch and wood floors. Wish they showed more of the interior. There are two detached storage sheds on the property. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,577 square feet. $248,000 Contact Monica Hanna with United Real Estate Richmond: 804-310-4518 From the Zillow listing: ADJUSTED PRICE…..Are you

item.title: TWO houses on 11 acres in West Virginia! Pretty setting with a pond. $399,900
item.description: This listing includes two houses! There is some nice acreage and it’s a pretty setting with a pond. The house was built in 1946. It is located on 11.5 acres in Alderson, West Virginia. Both houses could use some updating, but there is great potential there. One house is three bedrooms and one bathroom. The other is four bedrooms and two bathrooms. There is a nice pond and multiple outbuildings on the property. Seven bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,924 square feet. $399,900 Contact David and Cynd

item.title: Almost 10,000 square feet! Basement is so cool! C. 1926 in Wisconsin. $625,000
item.description: This seems like a lot of house for the money! I love that basement! It’s a big house with almost 10,000 square feet. The house was built in 1926. It is located on .36 acre in Green Bay, Wisconsin. The house features wood floors, grand staircase, arched windows with stained glass, baseboards, paneled den, crown moulding, vintage tiled bathrooms, built-in bookshelves, slate roof, basement with english style pub and built-in china cabinets. Five bedrooms, six bathrooms and 9,588 square feet. $625,0

item.title: Pretty details inside! Four bedrooms and four bathrooms. Over an acre in Alabama. $225,000
item.description: This house has pretty details inside! And it’s a big house with four bedrooms and four bathrooms! The house was built in 1955. It is located on 1.16 acres in Greenville, Alabama. The house features a covered front porch, beautiful arched windows, a large back deck, wood floors, tile flooring, built-in bookshelves, leaded glass, vaulted ceiling, crown moulding, wide baseboards, sunroom and a spacious kitchen. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and 3,356 square feet. $225,000 Contact Glenn P. Cooper wi

item.title: Alaska time! Four acres. Circa 1952. $359,000
item.description: Alaska time! Looks like a lush setting! The house was built in 1952. It is located on four acres in Homer, Alaska. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, big picture windows and a sauna. There is a large outbuilding on the property and a guest hut. item.title: Over three acres in NC with outbuildings! C. 1948. $180,000
item.description: This is a cute house! Love the acreage and outbuildings. The house was built in 1948. It is located on 3.16 acres in Fayetteville, North Carolina. The house features a covered side porch, original wood floors, baseboards, french doors, large fireplace and a huge back deck. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Adding some color inside would really help this house, but the price seems reasonable with the acreage. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,457 square feet. $180,000 Contact Naom

item.title: Nice interior! Has guest apartment! 15 minutes to Kerr Lake in Virginia. $219,900
item.description: This house has a nice interior! A lot of natural light. There is a guest apartment with a separate entrance. Only 15 minutes to Kerr Lake. The house was built in 1934. It is located on .36 acre in Chase City, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, a lot of natural light, brick fireplace, baseboards, crown moulding and an attached guest apartment with separate entrance. item.title: Pretty setting and area! Almost three acres in Virginia. $249,000
item.description: Pretty area of Virginia! The setting looks nice! They definitely need more interior pictures! The house was built in 1948. It is located on 2.92 acres in Stuart, Virginia. The house features an enclosed front porch, a back patio, original wood floors, baseboards and crown moulding. It would be nice to undo some of the renovations. Looks like there are seasonal views of a nearby pond. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 2,040 square feet. $249,000 Contact Karen Wilson with Five Star Mountain Realty:

item.title: Ozark Mountains cabin in Arkansas. Four acres overlooking a river. $199,000
item.description: This is a nice cabin in the Ozark Mountains. It sits high above the Spring River. The cabin was built in 1937. It is located on 4.34 acres in Highland, Arkansas. The house features a covered front porch, stone work, covered upper porch, wood floors, exposed beams, stone fireplace and bead board. The kitchen and bathrooms could use some work. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,512 square feet. $199,000 Contact Jeff Stone with Coldwell Banker Ozark Real Estate Company: 870-856-3206 From the Zillow
